newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIAN NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 10.
newsitem.headline: LATVIAN NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 10.

text.p: These were the headlines on Latvia's state radio at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- The Baltic states will get into the European Union in a second wave, an unnamed EU official said.
- President Ulmanis and Foreign Minister Valdis Birkavs are in Salzburg for the east Europe economic forum.
- Fatherland and Freedom/LNNK are to decide on their candidate for new state health minister.
- Alleged racketeer Boris Larionov has been brought to Riga from Naples.
